description: Convert PDF to Markdown for AI, also DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, Markdown or text, from a URL, a local file path or inline content. Returns Markdown (headings, lists, tables) built from visible content only, a report of what was removed (hidden/white/tiny/invisible text, hidden sheets or slides, prompt-injection lines), flagged items and an allow|warn|block verdict. Feed only `markdown` to the model. include_findings=true adds DocShield's full scan of every channel. Max 3 MB. Paid x402 $0.003 USDC on Base; only successful conversions are charged.

content.description: Inline HTML, Markdown or plain text

filename.description: File name with extension, helps format detection

include_findings.description: Also return docshield_findings: every channel scanned, what was removed and why

mode.description: strip removes injected blocks (default); flag keeps and lists them

path.description: Local file path (read by this MCP server on your machine)

name: docread_convert
